text:
marta: FYI opened PR to align partner-facing docs for SOC2/retention wording and add PowerShell + Java SDK export examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1205

devon: Link?

marta: PR covers: change 'TTL' -> 'retention period' across partner pages, add PowerShell sample for partners who automate exports, add Java example for partner integrations, and add a short note that exported actor identifiers are pseudonymized by default for partner exports.

tia: I'll take the PowerShell snippet and the partner note. Partners asked for a curl + PowerShell parity example.

andy: I'll add the Java snippet. Quick question: in partner docs do we show retention as numeric days (e.g., 90) or ISO duration? Partners prefer numeric when calling programmatically.

legal-bot: Preferred public phrasing: use 'retention period' and when discussing deletion add parenthetical: "(archival copies may persist per our backup policy)". Avoid definitive language about backups being purged. For partner exports add a line: "Partner exports will contain pseudonymized identifiers unless otherwise agreed in a contract."

marta: Thanks. We'll show 90 days as the standard example and mention ISO durations are accepted. Tia/andy, can you include <API_KEY> placeholders and remove any literal sample keys?

 tia: PowerShell snippet pushed to PR: ```powershell
$body = @{ scope = 'partner'; retention_days = 90; format = 'jsonl' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export' -Method Post -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <API_KEY>'; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Body $body | Out-File export.jsonl
```

andy: Java snippet added: ```java
RedwoodClient client = new RedwoodClient(System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
try (Stream<String> s = client.audit().export("partner", 90, "jsonl")) {
    s.forEach(System.out::println);
}
```

devon: CI linkchecker: two redirects found: `/sdk/java` -> should be `/sdk/java/quickstart`, and `/policies/retention` -> `/policies/data-retention`. CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/links/1205

linkchecker-bot: Broken/redirected links found in PR #1205: `/sdk/java`, `/policies/retention`.

marta: I'll fix the links. Also applying legal phrasing: replace 'destroyed' -> 'deleted from active storage' and append the backup parenthetical. Add the partner contract line from legal-bot.

tia: Added short partner FAQ blurb: "How are identifiers handled in exports?" Answer: "By default exports contain pseudonymized user identifiers (hashed or truncated); contact your account team for alternative arrangements."

andy: All good from eng. Tests pass on snippets. I also added a note showing how to supply ISO `P30D` if partners prefer that format.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Running link checks and lint for PR #1205

linkchecker-bot: PR #1205 link check: PASS after fixes

marta: Merged. I'll add a changelog entry and send a short note to partner success. Thanks everyone for the quick review.

devon: Great 44d. Make sure support knows exports have pseudonymized identifiers by default so they don't expect raw emails in partner deliveries.
